install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends r-base r-base-dev libxml2-dev r-cran-caret r-cran-doparallel r-cran-e1071 r-cran-foreach r-cran-gbm r-cran-ggplot2 r-cran-ipred r-cran-kernlab r-cran-mass r-cran-mlbench r-cran-nnet r-cran-party r-cran-patchwork r-cran-proc r-cran-randomforest r-cran-rcolorbrewer r-cran-rlist r-cran-rpart r-cran-xml && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/lib/R/site-library" && (grep -qxF "R_LIBS_USER=$HOME/.local/lib/R/site-library" ~/.Renviron 2>/dev/null || echo "R_LIBS_USER=$HOME/.local/lib/R/site-library" >> ~/.Renviron) && Rscript -e 'lib <- file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), ".local/lib/R/site-library"); .libPaths(c(lib, .libPaths())); if (!requireNamespace("Deriv", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/Deriv/Deriv_4.1.6.tar.gz", lib = lib, repos = NULL, type = "source"); pkgs <- c("adabag", "C50", "caretEnsemble", "neuralnet", "rattle", "rpart.plot"); missing <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]; if (length(missing) > 0) install.packages(missing, lib = lib, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", Ncpus = parallel::detectCores())'
